long_biography.plain_text:
Yannis Peroyannakis leads Petrochem General Management, an Athens shipping company that sits across much of the operating machinery of tanker transport. The business combines chartering, crewing, technical supervision, safety and daily vessel operations, serving oil-company cargoes through spot and longer-term contracts.

Petrochem began with smaller chemical carriers before adding medium-range product tankers through secondhand purchases. Under Peroyannakis, it moved into larger ships with two LR1/Panamax acquisitions and its first Suezmax newbuilding orders. The expansion broadened a fleet still concentrated on oil and chemical tankers, while keeping commercial and technical management inside the same operating platform.
